name: Maybank XL Rewards Card
highlights: 4 miles per S$1 on Dine, Shop, Travel and Play categories
4 miles per S$1 on Foreign Currency Spend
4 air miles per dollar (10X TREATS Point)* whenever you spend in the Dine, Shop, Travel and Play categories, as well as in Foreign currencies.
Up to 10,000 bonus TREATS Points monthly.
Other transactions will earn 5 TREATS Points for every S$5 spent.
Credit Cards with one of the widest number of spending categories in the market:
Dine: Restaurants, fast food, bakeries, food deliveries, etc
Shop: Apparels, departmental store, sports apparels, online shopping, etc
Travel: airlines, online travel agencies, etc
Play: bars, ktv, cinemas, online streaming, video game arcade, etc

annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Annual Principal Fee: S$87.20* (inclusive of GST), waived for first 2 years
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Fee Waiver: Subsequent waiver with min. spend of S$6,000 p.a.
annual-interest-rate-and-fees.Minimum Monthly Repayment: 3% of outstanding balance or S$20, whichever is higher, plus any outstanding amount "Past Due" from previous statements

minimum-income-requirements.Non-Singaporean Minimum Annual Income:
S$45,000 for Malaysia Citizens, in employment for at least 1 year 
S$60,000 for Foreigner, in employment for at least 1 year

our_takes.our-take: The Maybank XL Rewards Card is a strong entry-level miles card for younger spenders who want to earn up to ~4 miles per S$1 on both lifestyle spending and all foreign-currency purchases. Its standout feature is the broad bonus coverage—dining, shopping, travel, entertainment, and FCY spend—making it practical for everyday use and overseas transactions. However, its value depends heavily on meeting the monthly minimum spend and managing bonus caps, as rewards drop sharply if these conditions aren’t met.
our_takes.good-for:
Travellers and overseas online shoppers earning miles on FCY spend
Lifestyle spenders covering dining, shopping, and entertainment
Miles collectors with consistent monthly spend
Younger customers (21–39) starting a miles strategy
our_takes.things-to-note:
You must meet a monthly minimum spend to unlock 4 mpd; otherwise earn the base rate
Bonus miles are capped monthly—extra spend earns fewer miles
FX fees (~3.25%) apply despite bonus miles on FCY spend
TREATS Points expire quickly unless redeemed or pooled
Card is not available if you’re 40 or older
